Response that includes tool call output items

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\CreateResponseRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\CreateResponseRequest::from_json(json_encode(["input" => "What is the weather in San Francisco?", "model" => "gpt-4o", "tools" => [["description" => "Get current weather for a location", "name" => "get_weather", "parameters" => ["properties" => ["location" => ["type" => "string"]], "required" => ["location"], "type" => "object"], "toolType" => "function"]]]));
$apiKey = getenv('API_KEY');
if ($apiKey === false || $apiKey === '') {
    throw new RuntimeException('API_KEY must be set');
}
$client = LiterLlm::createClient($apiKey);
$result = $client->createResponse($req);
var_dump($result->id);
var_dump($result->status);
var_dump($result->getOutput());
```
